label: Archival service
definition: A gRPC service that serves point lookups of historical data from the Archival Store.

label: Archival store
definition: A long-term storage system that holds checkpoint-indexed Sui data.

label: Causal history
definition: The relationship between an object in Sui and its direct predecessors and successors.

label: Causal order
definition: A representation of the relationship between transactions and the objects they produce.

label: Certificate
definition: The mechanism proving a transaction was approved or certified.

label: Closed-loop token
definition: A token that can be used only for a specific service or authorized account.

label: DeepBook
definition: A decentralized central limit order book (CLOB) built on Sui.

label: Devnet
definition: A development network for trying new features. Its data is wiped regularly.

label: Epoch
definition: A period of about 24 hours during which the validator set and reference gas price stay fixed. Stake changes take effect at epoch boundaries.

label: Equivocation
definition: Signing two or more transactions that use the same owned object version at the same time. The object stays locked until the end of the epoch.

label: Finality
definition: The state in which a transaction is permanently recorded and cannot be revoked.

label: Gas
definition: The fee, paid in SUI, for a transaction's computation and the storage its objects use.

label: Localnet
definition: A Sui network that runs on your own machine for local development and testing.

label: Kiosk
definition: A Sui object that holds assets for display and sale, with transfer policies that the creator sets and the protocol enforces.

label: Mainnet
definition: Production network for live transactions and real-value assets.

label: Multi-writer objects
definition: Shared objects, which any transaction can read or modify, so Sui orders transactions that use them through consensus.

label: Mysticeti
definition: The consensus protocol used on Sui.

label: Object
definition: The basic unit of storage on Sui.

label: Operation cap
definition: A capability a validator can give another address so it can perform operational tasks, such as setting the gas price vote and reporting other validators.

label: Single-writer objects
definition: Objects owned by one address.

label: Soulbound
definition: An asset that is bound to an account and cannot be transferred.

label: Testnet
definition: Staging network for testing changes before production deployment.

label: Transaction
definition: A signed request that reads and modifies objects, such as transferring a coin or calling a Move function. It succeeds or fails as a whole.

label: Transfer
definition: Changing the owner of an asset.

label: Validator
definition: A node that holds stake, participates in consensus, and executes and certifies transactions. Validators earn staking rewards and vote on the reference gas price each epoch.

label: Wallet Standard
definition: A cross-chain standard that defines how apps can interact with wallets.

label: Consensus
definition: The process by which validators holding more than 2/3 of stake agree on the order of transactions. Sui uses the Mysticeti protocol.

label: Full node
definition: A node that stores the chain's state and history and serves it to apps through RPC. It does not take part in consensus.

label: DPoS
definition: Delegated proof-of-stake: the mechanism that sets each validator's voting power from the SUI staked with it, including stake from delegators.

label: Programmable transaction blocks
definition: A transaction made of up to 1,024 commands, where later commands can use earlier commands' results. All commands succeed or fail together.

label: System transactions
definition: Transactions the protocol creates for its own operations, such as epoch changes. Users cannot submit them.

label: MIST
definition: The smallest unit of SUI. 1 SUI = 1,000,000,000 MIST.

label: Move
definition: The programming language for smart contracts (packages) on Sui.

label: Quorum
definition: A set of validators whose combined voting power is greater than 2/3 of the total.

label: Sponsored transaction
definition: When one address pays the gas fee for a transaction submitted by another address.

label: Multisig
definition: An address controlled by up to 10 weighted keys. A transaction is valid when its signatures' weights reach the threshold.

label: gRPC API
definition: The full node API for reading chain data and submitting transactions.

label: General-purpose indexer
definition: The indexer that backs GraphQL RPC. It's built on the custom indexing framework.

label: GraphQL RPC
definition: A GraphQL API for querying Sui data, backed by an indexer.

label: zkLogin
definition: A Sui primitive that allows you to send transactions using an OAuth credential.

label: Checkpoint
definition: A batch of executed transactions, signed by a quorum of validators, that forms the record of chain history.

label: Address
definition: A 32-byte identifier for an account or object owner, derived from a public key and its signature scheme.

label: Faucet
definition: A service that provides free Testnet tokens.

label: Package
definition: A set of Move modules published together onchain as an immutable object.

label: Module
definition: A unit of Move code inside a package that declares types and functions.

label: Nautilus
definition: A framework for running offchain computation in a trusted execution environment, with results that Move contracts can verify onchain.
